applets.title: Calendar
applets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one 16:9 production background plate for Worldlet Village Calendar applet. Reference image is the actual village world map: match its rounded sculpted storybook 3D foliage, cream stone, warm timber, soft painterly materials, NOT photography. Close immersive view on a village garden veranda. Main subject is a LARGE FRONT-FACING blank cream paper hanging calendar writing surface on the LEFT, absolutely rectangular and parallel to the camera, NO perspective trapezoid: outer warm timber frame from x=4% to 65%, y=12% to 89%, inside clear cream paper from x=7% to 62%, y=21% to 84%. Brass hanging rings only above the paper, gentle material grain, no cast shadow or objects crossing the inner paper. The blank surface will receive real interactive HTML calendar, so DO NOT paint grids, dates, letters, numbers, schedules, buttons or content. A tasteful calendar emblem (tiny bound-page object without writing) and a few flowers can sit above the frame. RIGHT third is a beautiful bright village garden terrace with potted herbs, rounded apple trees and a glimpse of modest cottage architecture; upper right functional props, lower right x=71-96%,y=55-94% quiet empty pale stone for companion and speech. Rich detail around margins, use varied countryside setting, not mountains/bridges. Do not add person, animal, UI overlay, applet icon plinth, logos, watermark. Single finished background only.
